newsitem.title: USA: Chile buys Oriente, Nemba/Cabinda crudes for Sept.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys Oriente, Nemba/Cabinda crudes for Sept.

text.p: Chile's state oil refiner Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) purchased Ecuadorean Oriente and West African Nemba and Cabinda crudes in its latest tender, trade sources said on Friday.
ENAP bought the 380,000 barrel cargo of Oriente from an Ecuadorean trading house at an undisclosed discount to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing.
The company purchased the combination cargo of Nemba and Cabinda, totalling around 900,000 barrels, from a European major at a premium to Dated Brent, the sources said.
The cargoes are due to arrive September 16-20.
In its last tender in July, ENAP bought Oriente and Angolan Palanca.
